description: DCP service control. Starts, stops, restarts or reports the state of ONE named systemd unit. Security-critical: this is the only place a shell line exists. Both parameters arrive as environment data (interpolationType ENV_VAR), are constrained by SSM, and are validated again in the script.

Action.description: One of start, stop, restart, status.

UnitName.description: A systemd unit name such as nginx.service.

runCommand: case "$action" in start|stop|restart|status) ;; *) echo invalid_action >&2; exit 64 ;; esac
case "$unit" in ''|-*|*[!A-Za-z0-9@._-]*) echo invalid_unit >&2; exit 64 ;; esac
case "$unit" in *.service|*.socket|*.timer|*.target) ;; *) echo invalid_unit >&2; exit 64 ;; esac
if [ "${#unit}" -gt 160 ]; then echo invalid_unit >&2; exit 64; fi
if [ "$load" = not-found ]; then echo unit_not_found >&2; exit 4; fi
